SWK.confidence_in_thesis: medium-low - guidance and balance sheet are primary-sourced, but the implied-growth gap (7.4% vs about 4.5%) depends on whether the FY2026 FCF guide of $600-800m, which contains one-off refund cash and CAM taxes, is representative; WATCH rather than REJECT because the business and cost-out are real
SWK.thesis_one_line: Branded power-tools leader with a finished cost programme and a low P/E, but the price needs about 7% a year of cash-flow growth for ten years from a flat-sales base with one-off tariff and disposal items in the numbers.

Above. V1 base-case +18.1% a year used a 20.7x exit multiple against 14.8x today.

kill_criteria: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA declines YoY for a third consecutive quarter (Q3 FY26)
MGM China Segment Adjusted EBITDAR declines further or Macau GGR trends turn negative for two more quarters
Las Vegas Strip Resorts YoY growth breaks (the one clearly improving segment rolls over)
Any further goodwill/asset impairment in Regional Operations following the Northfield Park disposition precedent
key_adverse_facts: Confirmed via MGM's own Q2 FY26 8-K (not just the D4 headline file): the $48.30/share unsolicited proposal from 'People Incorporated' (2026-06-01) and its withdrawal (2026-09-24) are both real, primary-source-verified events

Event-study on daily closes: MGM +16.1% on the bid-report day and -11.0% on the withdrawal day (both idiosyncratic vs LVS/WYNN/CZR/SPY) -- the deal round-tripped roughly 10-13 points and nets close to a wash; ~20-23 of the cumulative -25.4% four-month decline is shared with Macau-exposed peers LVS (-22.9%) and WYNN (-19.9%), while Vegas/regional-only peer CZR is UP 1.9% over the same window -- points to a Macau-sector re-rating as the dominant driver, not primarily the failed deal

Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA fell YoY in both Q1 FY26 (-9%) and Q2 FY26 (-6%) even as GAAP net income improved sharply (Q2 FY26 $292.4m vs $49.0m PY) -- GAAP headline is flattered by one-off disposition/property gains while the operating trend is negative
MGM China Segment Adjusted EBITDAR fell 15% YoY in Q2 FY26 despite flat revenue and management's 'market share gains' framing

Operating lease liabilities of $23.8bn (triple-net master leases, principally VICI) dwarf conventional net debt of $3.5bn; rent coverage (EBITDAR+rent)/rent is only ~2.1x -- lease-adjusted leverage (~5.9x EBITDAR) is roughly 4 turns higher than the conventional net-debt/EBITDA read (~1.5x)
MGM issues no formal quantitative EPS/revenue/EBITDA guidance in any of the last five releases reviewed
data_conflicts: b1_live_scores.csv shows gp_a (gross-profit/assets) blank for MGM and n_Q=6 vs 7 for SWK/HAS -- the Quality family score rests on incomplete inputs, plausibly because the lease-heavy balance sheet does not map onto a gross-profit/assets construct
V1's EV ($11.92bn) excludes the $23.8bn operating lease liability, overstating cheapness on a lease-adjusted basis
V1's Street-target-based 'attractive' framing (target range $40-57) very likely predates the 2026-09-24 deal withdrawal and the Q2 FY26 Macau/regional EBITDAR miss and should be treated as stale
GAAP EPS trend (improving) directly contradicts the Adjusted-EBITDA trend (declining for two quarters)
b1's momentum/SUE inputs are likely stale relative to the -11% single-day move on 2026-09-24 and will not update until the next rebalance

DV28: Las Vegas Strip EBITDAR fell 7.6% YoY in Q1 FY26 (and 4% in Q4 FY25), so Q2 FY26 is the first growth quarter, not the second; the 29 Jul 2026 8-K confirms only that a People Incorporated proposal existed, not the $48.30 price or the 23-24 Sep withdrawal (press-sourced); People retains ~27% of MGM.
MGM.confidence_in_thesis: low-medium (Las Vegas Strip is genuinely improving, but Regional Operations and Macau are both shrinking on a profit basis, deal speculation has fully unwound, and lease-adjusted leverage is materially higher than the naive ratio suggests)
